content.comment_body: Hello, I've been using a computer with Windows 7 and was able to install [product_name] version 4 without any issues after an update. However, after switching to a computer running Windows 8, installation of the software is not possible. Do I need to purchase a new license? Please advise. Kind regards, [user_name]
Hi [user_name], You could try this: [url] Alternatively, if you wish, follow the suggestion from [user_name]: [product_name] v7 <> Windows 8

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing issues installing [product_name] on Windows 8, whereas installation was previously straightforward on Windows 7. There is uncertainty about whether a new license is required and confusion regarding software compatibility with newer operating systems.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope that installing [product_name] on Windows 8 will be as simple as on Windows 7. They also seek clear guidance on whether they need to transfer or purchase a new license for the new system.
